name: Frisia
alt: Frisian lands east of the Lauwers

predecessors.name: Frisian Kingdom
predecessors.text: the Frisian land east of the Lauwers, 33 cells, the same outline Cliopatria gives the 'Frisians' row in 793-799

successors.name: Kingdom of the Franks
successors.text: 'the area east of the Lauwers', conquered by Frankish troops in 785

ledger.x: 783: the Saxon Wars reach their fiercest phase.
785: Frankish troops conquer the Frisian land east of the Lauwers: 'Frankish troops conquered the area east of the Lauwers in 785, after Charlemagne defeated the Saxon leader Widukind.'

wars.name: Saxon Wars
wars.outcome: Frankish victory: 'Frankish annexation of Saxony'; Widukind was baptized in 785 and the last rebellion was defeated in 804.

certainty.note: The Lauwers is a river line named by the page; the coast and the Saxon frontier in the south are approximate.
